knowledge:
- key_parameters: poptag=Population identifier (e.g., "CEU") used in importing HapMap LD data ;; chrom=Chromosome identifier (e.g., "chr17") for the LD data ;; ldstruct=An S4 object of class ldstruct containing the LD matrix ;; lb=Lower bound threshold for the LD statistic (e.g., D' > 0.9) to select linked SNPs
- alternatives: snpStats=Mentioned as providing linkage disequilibrium analysis support, which ldblock aims to simplify for handling existing population-level data
- when_to_use: When you need to identify and extract a complete set of SNPs that are in linkage disequilibrium with a specific list of target SNPs (e.g., GWAS hits) using population-level LD data (such as HapMap).
- pitfalls: Not all GWAS SNPs are present in the HapMap LD resource, which may result in some input SNPs being dropped during expansion ;; User-provided LD data must strictly match the tabular format of the HapMap distribution to be imported correctly

workflows.name: snp_set_expansion
workflows.intent: Expand a set of target SNPs to include all SNPs in linkage disequilibrium above a specified threshold using population LD data.
input: ld_data.txt.gz (Gzipped tabular LD data in HapMap format)
target_snps.txt (A list of query SNP identifiers, such as GWAS hits)
workflows.stages: 1. Import HapMap-formatted LD data using hmld ;; 2. Define the target SNP set ;; 3. Expand the SNP set based on an LD threshold using expandSnpSet
workflows.code:
path = dir(system.file("hapmap", package="ldblock"), full=TRUE)
ceu17 = hmld(path, poptag="CEU", chrom="chr17")
exset = ldblock::expandSnpSet( rsh17, ldstruct= ceu17, lb=.9 )
